title: Upzoning near transit
summary: Allows more floor area on each site downtown, along the MLK Blvd corridor and in Blue Hill.

how: The Planning Commission reviews the proposal and makes a recommendation.
Residents comment at a Town Council public hearing.
Town Council votes on the rezoning.

evidence.claim: Auckland's 2016 upzoning of 3/4 of residential land significantly increased construction
evidence.source: Greenaway-McGrevy & Phillips (2023), Journal of Urban Economics

pros: More homes fit on each site, so land cost per home falls and more projects become profitable to build.
cons: Land prices rise toward the new allowance over about three years, taking back part of the gain.
Costs about $300,000 once, for the rezoning.
Taller, denser buildings in those areas.
